notes.title: Squidlit v1.09
notes.notes:
We have new updates!

[olist]
[*]The bug where you could talk to people while in the air has been fixed. As a result, text will always be in its box!
[*]The right analog sticks' sensitivity has been decreased. Plip will now be more careful on how often she squints.
[*]Text has been properly re-aligned! It should be ever-so-slightly easier on the eyes.
[/olist]

That's it for this go around! Make sure to follow us on twitter, @SuperSquidlit for information on our next title, Super Squidlit, coming this year!

notes.title: Squidlit v1.081
notes.notes:
Hello!

New changes to Squishu! All kinds of wonderful things have happened!

[list]
[*]Plip has generously donated her Game Squid so we can have lovely borders instead of black bars! How kind!
[*]Levi, the garbage theory ooblug, now no longer appears in town if Plip leaves her in her cell.
[*]Distracting the Blipston Band should now be easier!
[*]Plip's wiggle muscles have been made less sensitive, allowing her to run freely across the plains when mentally envisioning an analog stick to move.
[*]A glitch where pressing Up on the left analog stick while pausing the game, causing a crash, has been fixed.
[*]The right analog-stick's sensitivity for adjusting the contrast has been adjusted.
[/list]

See you all next time. Same squishy place, same squishy channel!

notes.title: Squidlit v1.71
notes.notes:
Several updates today as we fix the achievement "Good Squidlit" which requires wiggling at the end!

[list]
[*]"Yeah! That's Right! You did it! You're a good Squidlit!" will now activate properly when joysticks and arrowkeys are used!
[/list]

That's it for version 1.71! Stay tuned for Switch release information along with one final major update for the PC version!

notes.title: Squidlit Update v1.07!
notes.notes:
All kinds of changes have come to Squishu this time around! Here is what whirlwind changes have swept through your squidlity adventures!

[list]
[*]Plip has been brought back to the school-room and taught how to mentally envision analog/joysticks from controllers! She now responds to these properly.

[*]Plip has also been taught what arrow keys look like! She will respond to these as well.

[*]Game too eye-searingly bright? A new contrast slider has been implemented! Press "V" or Down on the right stick to make the game darker. Press "C" or Up on the right stick to make it lighter. Press "B" or click the right stick to reset the contrast.

[*]Sometimes Plip would squip and squoop her way between blocks in the ceiling. She has been told this is displeasing to the 3rd-dimensional beings watching her, and will now stop.

[*]Squidlits, Ooblugs, and all other talking creatures have been taught how to take pauses better. Dialogue should flow a bit better and be easier to read.

[*]Plip's jumps have been tuned! There's a lot of nitty and gritty detail here, it should be better. Let us know if it isn't!
[/list]

That's all the updates for this time around! Stay tuned for more Nintendo Switch information and Super Squidlit information!

We have finished tweaking achievements! They should all now be working. Please make sure that you are on the most recent version of the game by either logging out and logging back in on Steam, or by re-installing the game. We ended up uploading multiple patches yesterday, so if something doesn't work you most likely need to update.

Squishy regards!

notes.title: Squidlit v1.05 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
There have been a few changes in Squishu! Here are all the differences.

[list]
[*] Plip has been given more fiber in her muffins, making her more solid. She will no longer ooze into the ground when she's hurt by a Pbthantom in the ground. Hopefully.

[*]Skwit Skwot, God Emperor, has waxed her walls with a new solution. It should prevent squidlits from oozing into the walls in her labratory's cauldron room. She doesn't like how that looks.

[*]It was discovered that strange magical powers were left in the ink rain while words moved through the sky. These weird powers have been safely contained and removed. (Developer tools were accidentally left in)

[*]Skwit Skwot has reduced the amount of coffee in the recipe for oomunculi, causing them to spazz-out less.

[*]Plip has been taught how to properly interact with a crystal ball. I wonder what one could learn from it?

[*]Linnaeus, the ooblug within the library, will now give you a book counter if you talk to him deeper in rather than only near the entrance. 
[/list]

That's all for now! Stay tuned for more Squishu-themed announcements!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello all our squishy friends!

[list]
[*] The powers that be have decided to give the heroic Squidlit, Plip, some limited temporal ability! (To the pause screen, we have added "Restart Level", "Restart Game", and "Continue" options! It uses the placement of the traditional Nintendo "A", so the Xbox "B" or Playstation "O" will be the enter command for controllers.)

[*] There was a Pbthantom within Skwit Skwot, GOD EMPEROR's, laboratory that was pulling passing Squidlits into the ground! It was told that is rude, and has been placed in time-out.

[*] One of the intrepid Knights of the God Emperor seemed to have an issue with the wall he was stationed near. Upon looking back and finding that the muffin he was guarding stained the wall, he would start to clean it. A cleaning crew was dispatched, pleasing the Knight in question.
[/list]

That's all for this update!

notes.title: Happy Skwitanalia!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005881/3623ddd297b3ef567806d28dcbd9cb6a8299a82b.jpg[/img]

Every year the ooblugs celebrate Skwitanalia!  Each ooblug imagines super hard a single present that they want and it appears in Skwit Skwot, God Emperor's crystal ball. On the longest night of the year, Skwit Skwot flies around on her magical tome, Grimwar, creating and delivering the gifts to all of her subjects.*
But what's this? This year she's flying over Blipston too?

Shout out to the Yogscast Jingle Jam 2018 Humble Bundle featuring Squidlit! 100% of proceeds go to charity!

*Swords, bombs, bees, and wands are not available this year.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.03
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New changes are flowing through the world of Squishu and we're here to let you know what they mean for the average squidlit! Live from the Printed Raisin headquarters, Nosey squidlit is here for you!

	-It seems like some squidlits were caught defying the laws of physics lately by floating just above the ground! They were told that's kind of rude, so they apologized and should stop now.

	-Some squidlits have apparently had trouble figuring out how to talk to others! The Village Squizard, Thalmage, will now remind those he sees how it's done.

	-Looks like Skwit Skwot has taken to labeling things in her castle! There's a new sign over her catapult labeling it's use.

	-There were instances where squidlits were blacking out before they finished dealing with Skwit Skwot's plan! Inking in that cauldron must have dehydrated them. We now ensure that squidlits are properly hydrated before undertaking their quest!

	-Citizens of Blipston and Castletown have complained that the Imperially sanctioned ambiance music is still too loud, so Skwit Skwot has decreed it quieted down even more.

	-The Sharkerfly, having been beaten quite a few times now, is no longer as hard-core as it once was. It now winces when inked upon!

        -It seems like the dark rain of ink caused by squidlits now properly fades like a real storm, instead of popping out of existence!

	That's all for this round of changes to Squishu! Join us next time, at the Printed Raisin, for your latest Squishu news!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've made some changes!

- Fun fact, did you know that octopuses are deaf by human standards? Now we know why! The band will no longer compete for loudest Squidlit.

- Pressing F, like always, changes to windowed mode. Now, though, you can resize the super tiny screen into whatever size you want. Huzzah!

- We sent Ushanka (the squidlit who lives in a hole) and the Muffin Thief back to Squidlit School. They now understand proper wiggling etiquette.

- Pyrethrin is now the proud owner of a new Squidlit Repellent Canister, which is  more visible against the background.

- The farmer somehow understood the nuances of teleportation magic. We managed to convince him it's rude, and now he walks like a normal Ooblug after you talk to him.

Stay Squishy!

~Alex and Samantha

notes.title: Patch Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Our first patch! We fixed a few things.

-Fixed the Ooblug farmer! He was counting some Untzsnails twice, which caused him to freeze the game in confusion when you talk to him about the hovercraft. We taught him how to count better.

-We fixed the complaint about our letter "u" in the game's text. It should no longer look like it has a period next to it.

Thanks for enjoying Squidlit!

Squishy regards,

~Alex and Samantha
